title: LLM extraction from pathology archives identifies NSE as an Ewing sarcoma marker
summary: An LLM pipeline extracted 18 immunostains from Children's Oncology Group trial reports, with 98.2% mean accuracy against clinician annotation among 928 evaluable of 931 patients. NSE positivity (164 patients) was associated with inferior overall survival (5-year 61% versus 85%; HR 2.17, 95% CI 1.17-4.05), and high ENO2 transcript expression was associated with inferior survival in two independent cohorts (HR 1.86 and 3.94). The first version (2026-02-22) already contained the extraction-based NSE finding; the external transcript evaluation is described in a later version (2026-11-16). NSE is a candidate marker that needs protein-level validation.
ai_technology: Large language model pipeline extracting immunostain results from scanned pathology reports
organization: The University of Texas Southwestern Medical Center

evidence.tested: Extraction accuracy against clinician annotation, survival analysis in the archive cohort and transcript-level evaluation in two independent cohorts.
evidence.unknown: Retrospective; preprint with version differences; protein-level validation pending; candidate marker only; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: LLM pipeline recovered immunostain data from reports, enabling the survival screen.
